column2: a call stores its entry without looking at the flag first
the flag is not read again after the entry is stored
a call that finds the flag raised does not take its entry back
a call that finds the flag raised does not run the releaser
a call that finds the flag raised does not throw
a call that ends does not look at the flag
a call that ends runs the releaser when the flag is not raised
Dispose raises the flag and does not run the releaser
